description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, so `ListOS` lose filters the API takes. The official JS SDK sends them through `resolveOneOf` in `urlParams` — scaleway-sdk-js packages_generated/dedibox/src/v1/api.gen.ts — with the types in the sibling types.gen.ts. They are added as optional query members; the API enforces the one-of.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Filter OS by compatible server ID. One-of `filter`: at most one of `server_id`, `offer_id`.
